 "rationale": "A two-stage Miller amp with simple loads reaches only about 84 dB in sky130, so the first stage is a folded cascode (~70 dB) and a CS stage adds ~38 dB. NMOS input suits VCM=0.9 V. Cascode biases are replicated with diode+resistor generators. Current budget: tail 20 uA, folds 2x20 uA, stage 2 100 uA, bias 40 uA, giving about 180 uA (~325 uW). GBW = gm1/(2*pi*Cc) is about 8 MHz. gm7 ~0.8 mS gives PM > 60 deg."}

PARAMS = {
    "gmid1":   (15.0, 10.0, 20.0),     # input pair gm/Id
    "L1":      (0.5, 0.3, 1.5),        # input pair L
    "Itail":   (20e-6, 10e-6, 40e-6),  # tail current
    "Icas":    (10e-6, 5e-6, 20e-6),   # cascode branch current per side
    "I7":      (100e-6, 50e-6, 150e-6),# 2nd stage current
    "Cc":      (3e-12, 1.5e-12, 5e-12),
    "Lload":   (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # L of current sources / mirrors / 2nd stage
    "gmid_bot":(9.0, 6.0, 12.0),       # bottom NMOS mirror and 2nd-stage NMOS gm/Id
    "rzk":     (1.0, 0.5, 2.5),        # Rz = rzk*(1+CL/Cc)/gm7
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    CL = spec.get("cl", 5e-12); Iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    Itail, Icas, I7, Cc = p["Itail"], p["Icas"], p["I7"], p["Cc"]
    Lld, gmb = p["Lload"], p["gmid_bot"]
    Itop = Itail / 2 + Icas
    gmid_top, gmid_c, Lcp = 8.0, 10.0, 0.5
    vds_top, vds_bot = 0.3, 0.25
    Ipb = Icp = Icn = 10e-6

    # NMOS bias mirror from ibias
    gmid_nb, L_nb = 10.0, 1.0
    mnb  = lut.size("n", gmid_nb, L_nb, Iref, vds=0.65)
    m5   = lut.size("n", gmid_nb, L_nb, Itail, vds=0.3)
    mnpb = lut.size("n", gmid_nb, L_nb, Ipb, vds=0.8)
    mncp = lut.size("n", gmid_nb, L_nb, Icp, vds=0.5)

    # input pair
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], Itail / 2, vds=1.2, vsb=0.28)
    # top PMOS current sources and vbp diode
    m3   = lut.size("p", gmid_top, Lld, Itop, vds=vds_top)
    mpb  = lut.size("p", gmid_top, Lld, Ipb, vds=m3.vgs)
    mpcn = lut.size("p", gmid_top, Lld, Icn, vds=0.8)
    m8   = lut.size("p", gmid_top, Lld, I7, vds=0.9)
    # PMOS cascodes and their Vcp replica (diode + source resistor)
    mc1 = lut.size("p", gmid_c, Lcp, Icas, vds=0.8, vsb=vds_top)
    mpc = lut.size("p", gmid_c, Lcp, Icp, vds=mc1.vgs, vsb=vds_top)
    RP = vds_top / Icp
    # bottom NMOS wide-swing mirror, cascodes and Vcn replica
    mb  = lut.size("n", gmb, Lld, Icas, vds=vds_bot)
    mc3 = lut.size("n", gmid_c, Lld, Icas, vds=0.4, vsb=vds_bot)
    mnc = lut.size("n", gmid_c, Lld, Icn, vds=mc3.vgs, vsb=vds_bot)
    RN = vds_bot / Icn
    # second stage NMOS CS (same density as bottom mirror -> o1 sits near X)
    m7 = lut.size("n", gmb, Lld, I7, vds=0.9)
    Rz = p["rzk"] * (1 + CL / Cc) / m7.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.dev("MNB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mnb)
    n.dev("MNPB", "vbp", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mnpb)
    n.dev("MPB", "vbp", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", mpb)
    n.dev("MNCP", "vcp", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mncp)
    n.R("RP", "vdd", "sp", RP)
    n.dev("MPC", "vcp", "vcp", "sp", "vdd", mpc)
    n.dev("MPCN", "vcn", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", mpcn)
    n.dev("MNC", "vcn", "vcn", "sn", "vss", mnc)
    n.R("RN", "sn", "vss", RN)
    # first stage: vinn on diode (x) side, vinp on output (o1) side
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M1", "fa", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "fb", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "fa", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "fb", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("MC1", "x", "vcp", "fa", "vdd", mc1)
    n.dev("MC2", "o1", "vcp", "fb", "vdd", mc1)
    n.dev("MC3", "x", "vcn", "ya", "vss", mc3)
    n.dev("MC4", "o1", "vcn", "yb", "vss", mc3)
    n.dev("MB1", "ya", "x", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MB2", "yb", "x", "vss", "vss", mb)
    # second stage + compensation
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "o1", "vss", "vss", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", m8)
    n.R("RZ", "o1", "nc", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "nc", "vout", Cc)

    # predictions
    r_fold = 1.0 / (m3.gds + m1.gds)
    r_up = (mc1.gm + mc1.gmbs) / mc1.gds * r_fold
    r_dn = (mc3.gm + mc3.gmbs) / mc3.gds / mb.gds
    rout1 = r_up * r_dn / (r_up + r_dn)
    a1 = m1.gm * rout1
    a2 = m7.gm / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(a1 * a2)
    ugbw = m1.gm / (2 * PI * Cc)
    c1 = m7.cgg + mc1.cdd + mc3.cdd
    p2 = m7.gm * Cc / (2 * PI * (c1 * Cc + CL * Cc + c1 * CL))
    cfold = m1.cdd + m3.cdd + mc1.cgg
    p3 = (mc1.gm + mc1.gmbs) / (2 * PI * cfold)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p3))
    power = VDD * (Iref + Ipb + Icp + Icn + 2 * Itop + I7)
    swing = VDD - m7.vdsat - m8.vdsat - 0.1
    slew = min(Itail / Cc, I7 / (CL + Cc))
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "swing": swing, "slew": slew}
